mustache-error-no-template: Error message shown when {{#html:}} is used without specifying a page name.
mustache-error-invalid-template:
Error message shown when an invalid page name is provided to {{#html:}}.

Parameters:
* $1 - the invalid page name
mustache-error-template-not-found:
Error message shown when a specified HTML page does not exist.

Parameters: $1 - the page name that was not found
